QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredPx4MajorVersion
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Minimum PX4 firmware major version compared with the value reported by AUTOPILOT_VERSION. Set all version fields to zero to disable this check.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required PX4 major version

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredPx4MinorVersion
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Minimum PX4 firmware minor version when the reported major version matches the required major version.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required PX4 minor version

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredPx4PatchVersion
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Minimum PX4 firmware patch version when the reported major and minor versions match the required values.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required PX4 patch version

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: strictCompatibilityGate
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show operator warning for PX4 version mismatch
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, a PX4 version below the configured minimum produces an operator-visible warning at connection. When disabled, the mismatch is recorded in the log only.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Show strict PX4 version warning

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: trackerBoxSizePx
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Default click tracker box size in pixels
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When the operator single-clicks on the video, this fixed-size box is centered at the click point and sent to the trackers.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Tracker click box size

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: c12GimbalMaxSpeed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Upper bound for drag-derived C12 yaw/pitch speed commands. Units are protocol speed units (0.5 deg/s per unit).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: C12 max gimbal speed

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: passwordHashOverride
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: SHA-256 hex of the admin password set at runtime from the hidden admin dialog. Empty means use the compile-time hash.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Password hash override
